title: Online Submission Platform: UNCST NRIMS Portal
content: All protocol applications to the Makerere University Business School Research Ethics Committee (MUBS REC) must be submitted online via the Uganda National Council for Science and Technology (UNCST) National Research Information Management System (NRIMS) portal at: https://nrims.uncst.go.ug/ . Submissions and exemption requests must be made through this platform.
author: MUBS REC Secretariat

title: MUBSREC Mandatory Submission Checklist
content:
Complete submission package for MUBS REC clearance on NRIMS requires:
1. Full Proposal (Approved by supervisors and submitted to Graduate School)
2. CV of investigator/s or researchers
3. Community Engagement Plan
4. Risk Management Plan
5. Dissemination Plan
6. Data Collection Tools (translated where applicable)
7. Informed Consent Form (translated where applicable)
8. Letter from FGSR for students addressed to the Chairperson MUBS REC indicating they are due for REC clearance (For external/independent researchers: a formal letter addressed to Chairperson MUBS REC seeking REC clearance)
9. Work Plan
10. Proof of Payment (Receipt from the MUBS accounts office)

Note: For unique or sophisticated research (e.g. big data research), additional documents like a Data Management Plan are required. Check with the Secretariat for specialized requirements.
author: MUBS REC Secretariat

title: MUBSREC Resubmission Guidelines Following Reviewer Comments
content:
When resubmitting following REC reviewer comments:
• Track Version of Proposal: Turn on 'Track Changes' in Microsoft Word before making any edits so all adjustments are visible.
• Clean Version of Proposal: A clean copy with all Track Changes accepted/removed.
• Track Copies of all Appendices with comments.
• Clean Copies of all Appendices.
• Compliance Report / Comment Response Matrix addressing every single REC reviewer comment point-by-point.

CRITICAL: Please do NOT submit the compliance report from your oral defense. Only submit the compliance report specifically responding to REC reviewer comments.
author: MUBS REC Secretariat

title: Protocol Submission Timing & Fieldwork Clearance Policy
content:
Timing of Protocol Submission:
• MUBS Master's students: Shall submit their research protocols after their supervisor has approved the protocol.
• PhD students: Shall submit after successful oral defense of the proposal.

Mandatory Fieldwork Clearance:
• MUBS students shall ONLY be allowed to conduct field research after obtaining official ethical clearance from MUBS-REC.
author: MUBS REC Secretariat

title: Exemption from MUBS REC Review: Criteria & Procedure
content:
The following categories of research may be considered for exemption from MUBS REC review:
1. Use of publicly available unlinked data that does not identify individuals or communities.
2. Research conducted in educational settings focusing on regular or special instructional strategies, curricula, or classroom management methods.
3. Research involving existing data, documents, or records where sources are publicly available or where information cannot be linked to individual subjects.

Screening & Approval:
• The REC Chairperson shall screen all exemption applications to ensure that the protocol satisfies the requirements.
• Exemption decisions will be granted within fifteen (15) days from the date of submission.

Important Notes for Exemption:
• All exemption applications must be submitted through NRIMS (https://nrims.uncst.go.ug/).
• Proof of payment, as required, must be attached.
• A formal letter addressed to the Chairperson requesting exemption must accompany the application.
• All required supporting information and documentation should be attached for consideration.
author: MUBS REC Secretariat
